items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 8:42am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

S or SW, veering W or NW overnight, 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area at first, and in the west of the area overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then showers or longer spells of rain in the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

##Warnings)##

##Wind)##

NW or W 3 to 5, imminently increasing 5 or 6 for a time, then backing SW 3 or 4 later. Then increasing 5 or 6 late in the night.

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate at times.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.

16°C
